mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a temperature of 79 degrees under partly cloudy skies near Fireman's Park, with a real-feel of 84 degrees.

City updates include progress on road construction along Highway M where traffic patterns will shift starting the week of September 7th, and the upcoming closure of the Military Ridge State Trail from mid-September to mid-November for bridge replacement.

There is a lot going on in town, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness, and several trivia nights and the farmers market coming up on Tuesday and Wednesday.

The Verona Police Department announced that on Sunday, August 30th, an investigation led to the arrest of a 34-year-old Madison resident for the sexual assault of a child by a school staff member, which remains an active investigation.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
